claims: 5G is the fifth-generation global wireless standard.
5G is up to 100 times faster than 4G.
5G connects up to 1 million devices per square kilometer.
5G New Radio (NR) is the new global standard for the air interface.
5G New Radio utilizes sub-7 GHz frequencies.
5G New Radio utilizes frequencies above 24 GHz.
Massive MIMO is Multiple Input, Multiple Output.
Network slicing creates virtual, specialized networks on a single physical infrastructure.
